title: jamstate chart
description: A song skeleton: tempo, meter, key, genre, sections with chords, and the form. Never audio. Format v0.1 (docs/decisions/0013-chart-format-v0.1.md); every v0 chart is valid. The browser (web/src/core/chart.ts) enforces the same rules and also checks that chord symbols parse and the genre exists.

version.description: Chart format version. Optional; v0 charts have none.

genre.description: Genre pack id from genres/ (funk, blues-rock, jazz). Sets the groove, swing, feel and ending. Default blues-rock.

swing.description: 0 = straight, 0.66 = triplet swing, 1 = dotted. Overrides the genre's swing.

count_in.description: Bars the band counts in before the first bar.

chords.description: One entry per bar, cycled to fill the section. An entry with spaces splits the bar evenly, e.g. "Fm Eb".

intensity.description: Suggested band intensity for this section; the bandleader can override it.

swing.description: Overrides the song's swing for this section.

cymbal.description: Drummer keeps time on the hi-hat or the ride in this section (overrides the genre).
